summary: AGI Inc filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing its Q2 2026 earnings release and shareholder letter. The filing includes operational updates such as customer growth to 7.6 million, market share gains in INSS payroll credit, launch of a proprietary investment platform and Agi+ subscription service. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The document is a routine earnings announcement for a recent NYSE-listed foreign private issuer.
